posts.title: Taking inventory
posts.description: I am about three and a half weeks out from leaving on my travels. There is a tension that is building in my mind and body as the days tick closer. This is not the first time I have packed up my life and hit the road but something about this trip feels different. posts.title: The Dungeons of Empire
posts.description: A few months ago I wrote a piece called the moats of Europe which was about how border guards and frontex officials would use rivers as a way to deter migrants.
